nodes.label: CI workflow (ci.yml)
nodes.rationale: Runs the same checks a careful maintainer runs by hand, so a forgotten manual run can no longer ship a silently truncated core or a broken installer.

nodes.label: checks job (ubuntu and windows matrix)
nodes.rationale: Both operating systems are in the matrix because the shipped shell layer targets Git Bash on Windows and stock bash on Linux/macOS, and one past bug (a locale-dependent grep class) was catchable in only one of the two environments; the sandbox smoke test never touches the runner's real config.
